exposure: Dinoprostone vaginal system for labor induction
Vaginal birth within 24 hours vs. caesarean section
outcome: Maternal complications (tachysystole, hyperstimulation, oxytocin requirement, postpartum hemorrhage, cervical-vaginal tears, side effects)
Fetal outcomes (fetal distress, meconium-stained liquor, Apgar scores)
cohort: 103 pregnant women who underwent labor induction with dinoprostone vaginal system
finding: Age, parity, and cervical opening were associated with successful vaginal birth within 24 hours after dinoprostone induction, with rare maternal and fetal complications.
